s2 checks final actual request/authority/recipient before distinct send s3. s5 checks completed actual received records/notes/destination before distinct save s6; edits invalidate relevant gate.

Doctor's approval s4 occurs after the complete candidate exists; required edits return through s3 and renewed final doctor review. s5 only verifies exact unchanged approved version/identity/destination; any change returns for renewed doctor approval and final check.
